import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x141218e30")
f = prog.getFunctionManager().getFunctionAt(addr)
if f is None:
    raise RuntimeError("function absent")
out["signature"] = str(f.getSignature())
d = DecompInterface()
try:
    d.openProgram(prog)
    res = d.decompileFunction(f, 300, monitor)
    out["decompCompleted"] = bool(res.decompileCompleted())
    if not res.decompileCompleted():
        out["error"] = str(res.getErrorMessage())
    else:
        out["decompiled"] = res.getDecompiledFunction().getC()
    high = res.getHighFunction()
    if high is not None:
        ops = high.getPcodeOps()
        sample = []
        count = 0
        while ops.hasNext() and count < 40:
            monitor.checkCancelled()
            sample.append(str(ops.next()))
            count += 1
        out["pcode_sample"] = sample
finally:
    d.dispose()
print(json.dumps(out))
